paper.title: Wind farm layout and hub height optimization with a novel wake model

target_contributions: 3-5-6-1 artificial-neural-network surrogate of a three-dimensional analytical wake model
joint wind-turbine layout and hub-height optimization

source_assets.author_data: no paper-linked Shiren training array or trained weights located

energy_cases.e1: aligned layout and fixed 65 m height
energy_cases.e3: optimized layout and fixed 65 m height

cost_cases.c2: aligned layout and cost-aware optimized height
cost_cases.c4: cost-aware joint layout and height optimization

model_contract.wake: target Eqs. (1)-(3), completed by recovered 2018 single-wake and 2020 multiple-wake equations
model_contract.cost: digitized monotone Fig. 22 knots, linearly extrapolated from 60 m to the paper lower bound of 45 m
model_contract.objective_direction_resolution: maximize total power for E cases; minimize total installed cost divided by total power in USD/kW for C cases

training_contract.private_data_completion: deterministic stratified samples on the paper 0.01D Y/Z and 1D downstream lattice inside the analytical wake
training_contract.optimizer_completion: Adam, eight deterministic mini-batches per epoch
training_contract.h5_boundary: training lifecycle and generalization are admitted; the paper MSE target is reported, not assumed

optimizer_contract.encoding: real-valued x, y and hub-height variables per turbine

declared_completion.mutation: bounded Gaussian coordinate and hub-height mutation

hpc_contract.training: persistent full-core teacher generation, fixed gradient chunks and deterministic reduction
hpc_contract.optimization: persistent full-core population evaluation in every generation
hpc_contract.formal_resource_policy: maximum twenty aggregate Waffle CPU workers without nested oversubscription

claim_boundary: academic declared reproduction of every named paper case and the paper/cited equations; not author code, private Shiren data, author-trained weights, exact GA, exact cost curve or numerical replay
